historical_record.description: A multi-unit residence built 1961-65 to a design by Germano Milono.

Counted in 2010 among the four buildings of the First and Mission Historic District — a district not formally listed but found eligible for the California Register, and identified in the Transit Center District Area Plan Survey — all four of which stood on the site proposed for a three-tower development. Six storeys of offices and shops.

historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 4 that it may become eligible, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.
historic_survey.note: Recorded as an individually significant building. The survey prints this building's address two ways: 88 1st Street in one table and 500 Mission Street in another.
